# catalystcenter_assign_planned_access_points (Resource)

This resource assigns planned Access Points on a floor map to operational Access Points from the inventory. Planned APs are referenced by name, for example planned APs from a map archive import. For planned APs managed with `catalystcenter_planned_access_point_position`, use its `access_point_id` attribute instead. Each operational AP takes the position, height and antenna orientation of its planned AP and is assigned to the floor; Catalyst Center then removes the planned AP. <p/> Because the planned AP no longer exists after assignment, refresh only checks that each operational AP is still positioned on the floor. Destroy unassigns the operational APs from the floor, except provisioned APs, which Catalyst Center does not allow to be unassigned; the planned APs are not recreated.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "catalystcenter_assign_planned_access_points" "example" {
  floor_id = "5e6f7b3a-2b0b-4a7d-8b1c-0d4b1cd5e1b1"
  assignments = [
    {
      planned_access_point_name = "NAC-PLANNED-AP-01"
      access_point_id           = "b054deab-f9fc-48c9-88d0-ab82f029e6aa"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assignments` (Attributes Set) Planned Access Point to operational Access Point assignments (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assignments))
- `floor_id` (String) Floor ID where the planned Access Points are placed

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assignments`

Required:

- `access_point_id` (String) Network device ID of the operational Access Point
- `planned_access_point_name` (String) Name of the planned Access Point on the floor
